module: Flowgraph node "Fade From Black" (category once_f_duration): fades the screen in from black. Input "duration" (0.75 s by default). Duration output handled by setDurationState (flow "complete", former name "done"). Uses ui_fadeScreen.fadeFromBlack, or ends the loading screen (server.fadeoutLoadingScreen) if the game is loading.
notes: If the screen is already not black or if the fade was stopped, goes directly to the 'finished' state.
The 'finished' state also arrives through the onScreenFadeState(3) hook.

_executionStopped.desc: Resets the 'inactive' state and isFadeScreenActive = false.

onScreenFadeState.desc: Hook called by ui_fadeScreen with the fade state; state 3 ends the node.

state.desc: Screen fade state (1 = black reached, 3 = fade finished).

postInit.desc: Duration template: 0.75 (default duration of mission fades).

workOnce.desc: Starts the fade from black (or ends loading) and updates the duration state.
